sources.title: Piracy monthly report for April 2026（ANNEX：Acts of piracy and armed robbery allegedly committed / attempted against ships）
sources.text: Two unauthorised persons boarded a barge under tow. Nearby vessels alerted the tug master who boarded the barge for inspection resulting in the persons escaping. It was reported that two containers onboard the barge were broken into and contents stolen. Incident reported to the local authorities.
